stem: Deena wants to use a more effective and descriptive sentence to close the sixth paragraph (sentences 25-28). Which of the following could BEST replace sentence 28 and help accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: In seconds, the lighthouse and its occupants were all in a much better position.

options.label: B
options.text: In seconds, she would ask Captain Frank for help with what she needed to do.

options.label: C
options.text: In seconds, the light was on, and everything was fine in their part of the world.

options.label: D
options.text: In seconds, a warm glow filled the lighthouse and beamed out its many windows.

visual_elements: Image contains text of the question and answer options.
